# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is the **AI Engineering Handbook** — a from-scratch, hands-on guide
to becoming job-ready in AI Engineering.

Here is a formula, to prove the math renders:

$$
Q(s,a) \leftarrow Q(s,a) + \alpha\big[r + \gamma \max_{a'} Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)\big]
$$

And a code block, to prove code renders:

```python
def choose_action(state, Q, epsilon):
    if random.random() < epsilon:
        return random.randint(0, n_actions - 1)   # explore
    return int(np.argmax(Q[state]))               # exploit
```
